questions.scenario: You are organizing a house party for your friends. What is your main job?

options.text: Welcoming everyone warmly and making sure the house looks beautiful.
Staying in the kitchen, experimenting, and making the best snacks.
Planning the exact timeline of games, music, and activities.
Coordinating everyone's rides so they arrive and leave safely and on time.
Designing the party theme, setting up the lighting, and managing the DJ/music.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You are on a family vacation. What excites you the most?

options.text: The luxury, swimming pool, and room service of the 5-star hotel.
Trying the local street food and finding the best restaurants.
Holding the map and exploring hidden waterfalls or monuments.
Staring out of the airplane window, fascinated by the flight.
Attending a massive local music festival, carnival, or cultural parade.
None of these.

questions.scenario: If you were given a superpower, what would it be?

options.text: The ability to make anyone feel instantly relaxed and happy.
The magic to turn basic ingredients into mind-blowing delicious food.
The power to teleport to any beautiful location in the world instantly.
The ability to fly high through the clouds like a bird.
The ability to instantly organize and flawlessly execute a massive concert for thousands.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You are scrolling through YouTube. Which vlog do you click on?

options.text: 'Inside a $10,000 per night underwater luxury resort.'
'How to bake the perfect, cheesy, crispy pizza at home.'
'Top 10 hidden gems and secret beaches you must visit in Europe.'
'A day in the life of an Airline Pilot / Flight Attendant.'
'Behind the scenes of planning a million-dollar celebrity wedding.'
None of these.

questions.scenario: During a massive school fest, what role would you choose?

options.text: The Front Desk: Welcoming guests with a bright smile and helping them.
The Food Stall: Cooking, plating, and serving dishes to the crowd.
The Guide: Taking parents on a campus tour and explaining everything.
The Announcer: Making sure rules and safety announcements are perfectly delivered.
The Core Organizer: Managing the budget, stage setup, and coordinating all teams.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Every job has a tough/boring part. Which of these can you tolerate easily?

options.text: Smiling and staying perfectly polite even when someone is shouting at you.
Standing in a hot environment and chopping 100 onions without complaining.
Sitting for hours to book tickets, check schedules, and fix cancellations.
Waking up at 2 AM, wearing a strict uniform, and following a safety checklist.
Running around for 15 hours straight fixing last-minute backstage emergencies.
None of these.

questions.scenario: What catches your eye when you watch a movie?

options.text: The grand lobbies, chandeliers, and beautiful interior decor.
The delicious-looking feasts and beautifully decorated dining tables.
The beautiful mountains, beaches, and road trips the characters take.
The smart uniforms, the airplanes, and the glamour of the airports.
The incredible concert scenes, massive parties, or grand royal weddings.
None of these.

questions.scenario: How do you prefer to spend your free time or nurture a hobby?

options.text: Organizing my room to look perfectly clean and premium like a suite.
Experimenting with new recipes, chocolates, or spices in the kitchen.
Looking at world maps, reading travel blogs, or collecting souvenirs.
Playing flight simulator games or reading about different aircraft.
Planning hypothetical dream parties or scrolling through aesthetic event decor ideas.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Your best friend's birthday is coming up. How do you surprise them?

options.text: Book a beautiful venue, decorate it, and manage the guest list.
Bake a highly customized, multi-layer birthday cake yourself.
Plan a surprise road trip or adventure outing for the whole group.
Gift them a ticket for a helicopter ride or a parasailing adventure.
Hire a live band, set up a flash mob, or throw a massive themed costume party.
None of these.

questions.scenario: If you had a specific title in your friend group, what would it be?

options.text: The Host (Always makes everyone feel comfortable).
The Foodie (Always knows the best places to eat and cooks well).
The Guide (Always plans the trips, routes, and budget).
The Captain (Loves discipline, travel, and high standards).
The Planner (Always organizing the parties, farewells, and get-togethers).
None of these.
